verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO Keys are hardware authentication tokens (FIDO2/U2F, PIV, OTP). Setting up autonomous background automations is a category error for this kind of product. The HOTP keyboard-emulation feature only types a one-time code when the key is used, so it is not an automation capability and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
